task: spec 003 T035: scoped re-fetch of the jumper-dependent pages; each setting's draws recorded verbatim
decision: Decision 10 (docs/evidence/OPEN_DECISIONS_2026-10-30_RESEARCH.md): run T035 free, no paid cap

fetch.client: Python urllib.request GET, no renderer, no proxy
fetch.raw_html_note: Raw HTML stayed in the session scratchpad; content_sha256 identifies each fetched body.

page_list.rule: Every 4ms Company row except the Row Power rows, plus every Dave Jones Design row and every Velectronic row. No 4ms row is marked retired in committed data (no status field on the rows, and none in overlays/catalog-retirements-v1.json), so none was dropped for retirement.
page_list.estimate_note: tasks.md and research.md R5 estimated 42 live 4ms modules; committed data gives 39 4ms pages (44 rows minus 5 Row Power), 42 pages in all.

schema.pages[].quote: The page's power block, verbatim from the visible text (HTML tags removed, entities decoded, runs of spaces collapsed; line breaks kept as \n).
schema.pages[].settings[].kind: jumper (a power-source jumper or switch), configuration (with/without an expander), load_condition (stated measurement conditions), or single.
schema.pages[].settings[].label: The setting's label as printed on the page when label_on_page is true; null or a descriptive name otherwise.
schema.pages[].settings[].rails[rail].status: stated (a number given), not_used (the page says not used or none), or not_stated (the page gives nothing for this rail and this setting).
schema.pages[].settings[].rails[rail].ma: Integer read from the quote; null when not given. Never filled from another source.
schema.pages[].settings[].rails[rail].quote: Substring of pages[].quote that states this value; null only when status is not_stated.
schema.pages[].settings[].rails[rail].unit_stat: false when the page gives the number without 'mA' (4ms VCA Matrix '80 max').
schema.pages[].settings[].unattributed_draw: A draw the page gives without naming a rail; never assigned to a rail.

for_t034: Load only pages with jumper_dependent true into power_configs; single-setting pages need no setting picker.
Match rows by brand and source url (pages[].url equals the crawl row's source_url).
Otool's two alternatives are not labelled on the page; the picker needs neutral labels or an owner mapping.
Spectral Multiband Resonator's base setting is unlabelled on the page; only 'when jumper set to +12V' is named.
Dual Looping Delay states only 'jumper set to 5V'; the other setting is not stated, so it has one config.
4ms VCA Matrix +12V external-5V value has no unit on the page (unit_stated false); decide before loading.
No page names a factory default except Velectronic A-Envelope ('Recommended' on the +5V jumper).
